name: 2N7002
title: 60 V small-signal N-channel enhancement MOSFETs: 2N7000 (TO-92), 2N7002 and NDS7002A (SOT-23)

source.revision: NDS7002A/D Rev. 11, March 2025; case outlines 98AON13880G (135AN, issue O, 31 Jul 2016) and 98AON13879G (135AR, issue O, 30 Sep 2016)

summary: Three 60 V N-channel enhancement-mode DMOS transistors: the 2N7000 in a three-lead TO-92, and the 2N7002 and NDS7002A in the three-lead SOT-23. They switch small loads and drive the gates of larger MOSFETs. The three differ in current rating, on-resistance limit and thermal resistance: the NDS7002A is the strongest SOT-23 grade (280 mA continuous, 2 Ω max at 10 V), the 2N7002 the lightest (115 mA, 7.5 Ω max). Gate threshold is 0.8 to 3 V for the 2N7000 and 1 to 2.5 V for the SOT-23 parts.

circuits.description: The setup for the turn-on and turn-off times. A pulse generator VGS drives the gate through RGEN; VIN is taken at the gate itself. The drain hangs from VDD through the load resistor RL and is the output VOUT; the source goes to ground. For the 2N7002 and NDS7002A the values are VDD = 30 V, RL = 150 Ω, RGEN = 25 Ω with a 10 V gate pulse (ID = 200 mA); for the 2N7000, VDD = 15 V, RL = 25 Ω, RGEN = 25 Ω (ID = 500 mA).

operation.text: All three hold off 60 V and take ±20 V on the gate. The 2N7000 is the through-hole TO-92 part, with the lowest thermal resistance (312.5 °C/W) and 400 mW dissipation. Of the two SOT-23 parts, the NDS7002A carries 280 mA continuous and 1.5 A pulsed with RDS(on) at most 2 Ω at 10 V and 3 Ω at 5 V; the 2N7002 carries 115 mA and 800 mA pulsed with at most 7.5 Ω at either gate voltage, and 625 °C/W. The two SOT-23 parts share the same threshold, capacitances and switching times.

On-resistance is guaranteed at 10 V and at 5 V of gate drive for the SOT-23 parts, and at 10 V and 4.5 V for the 2N7000. Typical normalized on-resistance climbs steeply with drain current at gate drives of 6 V and below (Figure 2). Threshold falls with temperature, to about 0.8 of its 25 °C value at 150 °C (Figure 6).

RDS(on) roughly doubles from 25 °C to 150 °C (Figure 3). Dissipation derates linearly above 25 °C: 3.2 mW/°C for the 2N7000, 1.6 mW/°C for the 2N7002 and 2.4 mW/°C for the NDS7002A. Junction and storage range is -55 to 150 °C, or -65 to 150 °C for the NDS7002A.
The source-drain body diode is rated for the same continuous current as the channel (115 mA 2N7002, 280 mA NDS7002A) and 0.8 A or 1.5 A pulsed. Its forward drop is 0.88 V typical.
Rated HBM above 100 V and CDM above 2 kV. The parts contain no lead and no halogens.

The TO-92 part carries the onsemi logo with assembly plant and date codes over 2N 7000. The SOT-23 parts carry a device code (702 for the 2N7002, 712 for the NDS7002A), a date code M and a dot marking the Pb-free package; the dot may sit in either of two positions.
